def shuffled(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> list[int]:
    """Return xs in a pseudo-random permutation determined by seed."""
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    ex shuffled([], 0) == []
    ex shuffled([1], 42) == [1]
    n = xs.len()
    if n <= 1:
        return xs.copy()
    out = xs.copy()
    m = 2147483647
    state = seed % (m - 1)
    if state < 0:
        state += m - 1
    state += 1
    i = n - 1
    while i > 0:
        state = (state * 48271) % m
        j = state % (i + 1)
        temp = out[i]
        out[i] = out[j]
        out[j] = temp
        i -= 1
    return out
